purpose: Teach: ゴージャス/重荷/土星/母乳/モザイク/軍艦/パジャマ/タマネギ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがゴージャスな宴会を開かれたぞ
lines.en: You know, Gran — when I was young, my father threw quite the celebration.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze into memory. Warm nostalgia threading through each word. Steady, unhurried pace. The voice of someone who has held this moment for decades.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、長男誕生を重荷ではなく喜びとされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, he really did celebrate your brother's birth as a joy, not a burden, didn't he?
lines.style: Gentle affirmation, looking at him with knowing tenderness. Voice steady and present. A light touch on the familiar pronoun — she's reassuring him of something he already knows but needs to hear again.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが土星の輪のお話をされたぞ
lines.en: Gran — when I was young, my father used to tell us stories about Saturn's rings.
lines.style: Eyes distant again. Voice opens wider, almost wondering. Slower pace on the image. Letting the detail settle like he's seeing it anew.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、私の母乳育児を応援して下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he was so supportive of me nursing our children, wasn't he?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact warmth. No performance in it — just stating what was true. A small knowing smile in her voice. Affirming his father's gentleness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがモザイク模様の工芸品を集められたぞ
lines.en: Gran — when I was young, my father collected the most beautiful mosaic pieces.
lines.style: Pause before the image. Reverent, almost. Voice softens on 'mosaic.' Slow, deliberate cadence — he's reconstructing the beauty of those objects in sound.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、軍艦島の歴史をご説明されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He explained the history of Gunkanjima to us so patiently, remember?
lines.style: Bright recollection. Her voice carries the pleasure of watching him teach. Steady, engaged rhythm. A hint of 'look at what he was' underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが孫にパジャマを買ってこられたぞ
lines.en: Gran — when I was young, my father brought home pajamas for all the grandchildren.
lines.style: Voice catches slightly on the specific kindness. Tender, almost fragile. Slower on 'brought home' — the weight of that small gesture held in the words.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お庭でタマネギも育てられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He grew onions in the garden too, didn't he? Always thinking of something practical and good.
lines.style: Soft, close. Voice almost confessional — she's reminding him of all the small, daily kindnesses. Warm and low. A small trailing-off at the end, like she's running her hand over memory.
